jobs_results.title: ENGINYER/A DE DISSENY ELECTRÒNIC DE HARDWARE
jobs_results.description:
Des de Marlex estem col·laborant amb una important empresa ubicada a la comarca d’Osona, dedicada al sector del metall, que actualment té la necessitat d’incorporar al seu equip a un/una Enginyer/a de Disseny Electrònic de Hardware.

Empresa dedicada a oferir serveis integrals de disseny i fabricació de sistemes i productes electrònics pel sector de l’automoció i el sector industrial:

Quina serà la teva missió a l’empresa?

En dependència del/la responsable de departament, la persona seleccionada s’ocuparà de:
• Desenvolupar hardwares electrònics per a dispositius mecatrònics.
• Elaborar les especificacions per desenvolupar i portar a terme el projecte.
• Definir el procés de disseny de layout dels productes electrònics.
• Dissenyar, desenvolupar i avaluar els prototips.
• Proposar millores per a donar un valor afegit al producte tenint en compte els avenços del mercat.
• Validar els diferents components electrònics seleccionats pel producte.
• Seleccionar nous components per a la... millora de producte.
• Encarregar-se de la documentació tècnica del projecte.

Al perfil seleccionat se li ofereix:
• Treballar en una empresa amb renom i ben consolidada dins els seu sector.
• Estabilitat i pla de carrera dins de l’empresa.
• Formació contínua interna.
• Horari flexible de dilluns a dijous en torn partit i divendres intensiu.
• Bon ambient de treball.

Requisits:

Ets el/la candidat/a ideal si tens...
• Formació en Enginyeria Industrial Electrònica, Telecomunicacions o similar.
• Experiència mínima de 3 anys en posició similar.
• Coneixements de llenguatge de programació.
• Experiència en disseny de layouts de PCB i en software de disseny Altium Designer.
• Experiència en verificació i avaluació de prototips.
• Es valorarà coneixements de software CAD mecànic.
• Nivell elevat d’anglès.
• Actitud proactiva, polivalent i capacitat de treball en equip

jobs_results.title: Hardware Field Service Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Together, we can beat cancer.

At Varian, a Siemens Healthineers Company, we bring together the world's best talent to realize our vision of a world without fear of cancer. Together, we work passionately to develop and deliver easy-to-use, efficient oncology solutions.

We are part of an incredible community of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, to improve people’s lives around the world. We embrace a culture of inclusivity in which the power and potential of every individual can be unleashed. We spark ideas that lead to positive impact and continued success.

If you want to be part of this important mission, we want to hear from you.

Main Location: Barcelona

Major Responsibilities
• Service and maintain complex Varian Medical Systems (VMS) products according to technical documentation provided.
• Instruct customers in operating and maintaining our products, to ensure customers/users are... self-sufficient in operating their equipment.
• Provide phone support / remote assistance to customers and to the Field Engineer as required.
• Order spare parts for assigned customers including replenishing spare parts kits for warranty and contract customers. Advise and assist customers in ordering spare parts or on service requests.
• Report by means of Field Service Reports/time sheets/expense reports etc. (as applicable) regularly / weekly.
• Input detailed records of service visits into company information systems, including technical problems, actions taken, and parts employed to correct these problems.
• Maintain up-to-date technical documentation, in order to permanently keep informed regarding all operating characteristics, design factors, technical performance, and developments of VMS products.
• Maintain a high degree of professional knowledge and safety consciousness according to our guidelines.

Qualifications And Experience
• Graduate or Bachelor of Technical Institute in electronics, electrical/biomedical engineering, related fields, or equivalent education.
• You bring 1 – 2 years of related experience preferred.
• Sound understanding of customers and their requirements as well as knowledge and application.
• Professional experience in electronic engineering, and testing equipment used for verification, checkout, and calibration of our products.
• Sound knowledge of and professional technical experience with microcomputers / PC-based systems.
• Articulate and skilled in interpersonal communication.
• Fluency in Spanish and English (other European languages desirable).
• Willing to work normal and non-normal hours as required to support the customers and to travel extensively (up to 60%, occasionally also abroad).

Varian is required to comply with all local and applicable regulations that may be associated with vaccine requirements for certain roles.

Fighting cancer calls for big ideas.

We envision a world without fear of cancer. Achieving this vision takes dedication and commitment from all of us, every single day. That's why we celebrate and value the distinctly beautiful and intersectional identities of each of our employees. We are a mirror of our patient-base, which allows us to innovate. Big ideas come from everywhere, and the best ideas are fostered by our unique individual experiences. At Varian, we encourage you to bring your whole self to work and believe your bold and authentic perspective will help to power more victories over cancer.

#TogetherWeFight

Privacy Statement

jobs_results.title: Hardware & Firmware Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Desde la división tecnológica de LHH en Andalucía estamos gestionando la búsqueda de un perfil Hardware + Firmware, para uno de nuestros clientes del sector biotecnológico.

Concretamente buscamos un ingeniero electrónico que aporte amplia experiencia en hardware, aunque también necesitaremos que se aporten conocimientos en la parte firmware.

Necesitamos profesionales con experiencia utilizando software de diseño electrónico, concretamente Eagle (también podemos valorar Altium).

En la parte de microcontroladores, principalmente valoraremos conocimiento y experiencia con STM32.

Posición 100% presencial en Sevilla.

Horario flexible: 8 h al día con entrada flexible entre las 7.30 y las 9.30 am.

Si necesitas más detalles sobre el proyecto y condiciones, no dudes en aplicar o contactarme directamente a luis.marquez@lhh.com

jobs_results.title: Large Format Hardware Distribution Center Support Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Job Summary

This role is responsible for designing engineering solutions by applying developed subject matter knowledge. The role includes tasks such as creating cost estimates, time standards, and operational procedures for new product introductions. The role collaborates with stakeholders for compliance, issue resolution, and continuous improvement. The role contributes to developing reliable and cost-effective manufacturing solutions for moderately complex products.

Responsibilities
• Designs engineering solutions, including methods, operation sequences, and processes for the manufacturing of parts, component sub- assemblies, and final assemblies, based on established engineering principles and general specifications and requirements.
• Develops and implements cost estimates, capacity models, time standards, production area layouts, and recommendations for tooling and process requirements for new product introductions.
• Develops operating procedures, safety protocols, and... maintenance plans for large scale manufacturing equipment.
• Assists with issue diagnosis and problem-solving, while aiming for continuous improvement.
• Collaborates and communicates with management, internal, and outsourced manufacturing and development partners regarding process and standards compliance, recording and reporting issues, and recommendations for problem resolution for manufacture of existing products.
• Works as part of the project team of other manufacturing engineers and internal and outsourced manufacturing partners to develop and execute reliable, cost effective and high quality manufacturing solutions for moderately-complex products from new- product introduction through end of lifecycle.
• Represents the manufacturing engineering team for all phases of larger and more- complex development and manufacturing projects.
• Solves difficult and complex problems with fresh perspective, demonstrating good judgment in selecting creative solutions and managing projects independently.
• Delivers professionally written reports, and supports realization of operational and strategic plans.
• Provides guidance and mentoring to less- experienced staff members to set an example of manufacturing engineering design and development innovation and excellence.

Education & Experience Recommended
• Four-year or Graduate Degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
• Typically has 4-7 years of work experience, preferably in engineering design and solutions, or a related field or an advanced degree with 3-5 years of work experience.

Preferred Certifications
• Six Sigma Certification
• American Production And Inventory Control Society (APICS) Certification

Knowledge & Skills
• Agile Methodology
• Automation
• Computer Science
• Continuous Improvement Process
• Data Analysis
• Electrical Engineering
• Engineering Management
• Lean Manufacturing
• Manufacturing Engineering
• Manufacturing Processes
• Mechanical Engineering
• New Product Development
• Process Improvement
• Project Management
• Python (Programming Language)
• Software Development
• Software Engineering
• Supply Chain
• Systems Engineering
• Tooling

Cross-Org Skills
• Effective Communication
• Results Orientation
• Learning Agility
• Digital Fluency
• Customer Centricity

Impact & Scope
• Impacts multiple teams and may act as a team or project leader providing direction to team activities and facilitates information validation and team decision making process.

Complexity
• Responds to moderately complex issues within established guidelines.

Disclaimer
• This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

What We Offer
• Opportunity to work in an international organization with colleagues coming from all over the world.
• Diverse, continued internal growth and career opportunities. Including HP’s own learning platform and LinkedIn Learning.
• An attractive benefits package:
• Health & Life insurance
• Lunch at reduced prices at our canteen/ ticket restaurant vouchers
• HP product discount
• Work life balance / flexible working hours.
• Women, Pride, Young employees, Sustainability and DisAbility! Just a few of our fantastic global business networks you can get involved with locally.
• We also dedicate time and resources to contribute with our community through Corporate Volunteering activities, including our onsite HP Charity day.
• Do you like to give back to the community? Then join one of our many volunteering teams or be a part of the incredible HP charity day held on site annually.
• Love sports? Then take advantage of our sports center (indoor and outdoor) with 25+ regular coordinated activities.
• We have an onsite Doctor and medical team for our employees, including services such as: nutrition, physiotherapy, and general health.
• Printing Happy hour – from photographs to large posters. And Hands-on workshops to print with the latest technology – from wall covers to 3D printed models.
• Dedicated lactation room
• Our Women Network organizes activities such as Networking, the promotion of STEM vocations, talks on, improving business acumen, work life balance and skills of the future, etc

jobs_results.title: Hardware Testing Engineer
jobs_results.description:
If you are one of those who, after parking, double-check that the car is closed… Your place is here!

We are expanding our teams in the Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS) Division, we are looking for a Testing Engineer, to take care of the assurance of HW product conformities: requirements, certifications and internal quality standards.

We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website.

WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON?

In our team you will be in charge of the planning, definition, execution and reporting of the verification and validation of HW products during the design, prototyping, pre-series and production phases. Development of tools, set-up of the environment, installation of the system under tests, etc.
• Validation, Verification and HW Testing.
• HW Equipment Certifications (CE, others).
• Design of HW systems and their firmware.
• Experience in requirements and test management tools, test execution... defect management, configuration management.
• Production of PCBs, knowledge of components, types of soldering, assembly methods, etc.
• Programming microcontrollers.
• Manufacture of prototypes.
• Design and programming of VHDL systems.
• Experience in production quality control.

WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?

For this position, we are looking for Engineers with experience in Technologies: Matlab, simulink, LabVIEW, Scripting, C#, C/C++, assembler and theoretical knowledge of Systems Engineering.

We also value experience in Intelligent Transportation System products.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

💻 Flexible start and finish times, and intensive working hours Fridays and in summer.

🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support.

🌍 National and international mobility. Do you come from another country? We can offer you a relocation package.

💰 Competitive compensation with ongoing reviews, flexible compensation and discount on brands.

💪Wellbeing program: Health, dental and accident insurance; free fruit and coffee, physical, mental and financialhealth training, and much more!

⚠️ In our recruitment processes you will always have telephone and personal contact, face-to-face or online, with our talent acquisition team. In addition, bank transfers and bank cards will never be requested. If you are contacted through any other process, please write to our team at privacy@gmv.com

❤️We promote equal opportunities in recruitment, and we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? JOIN US

If you have any questions please do not hesitate to contact Alejandra Estévez Melgarejo, in charge of this vacancy.

Alejandra Estévez Melgarejo

jobs_results.title: Hardware Product Engineer
jobs_results.description:
¡En K-LAGAN te buscamos para seguir creciendo juntos!

Somos una empresa internacional de servicios tecnológicos estratégicos, esencialmente comprometida con nuestro equipo y con la sociedad. Ofrecemos soluciones en servicios informáticos, desarrollos de ingeniería, electrónica y proyectos de I+D. Nuestro compromiso es contratar a los mejores talentos sin distinción de raza, religión, género, edad y otras capacidades, promoviendo su desarrollo profesional y personal.

Misión: Te incorporarás a uno de nuestros clientes dedicado al desarrollo de equipos electrónicos para productos de línea blanca. Trabajarás en el departamento de hardware como especialista tanto de diseño de PCBs como de electrónica de potencia.

Nuestro perfil ideal tiene conocimientos en:
• Diseño de sistemas basados en microcontroladores que incluyen interfaces de usuario, control de máquina (AC/DC input/outputs) y control de motores (Universal, ACIM,BLDC...).
• Convertidor DC/DC y AC/DC.
• Control de motores... trifásicos (inversores)
• Elaboración de informes técnicos.
• Convertidores electrónicos de potencia (BJT, Mosfet, IGBT,...).
• Conocimiento en electrónica de potencia.
• Inglés

Nuestro proceso de selección:
• Primera entrevista
• Entrevista técnica
• Entrevista final

Además, en K-LAGAN queremos que disfrutes de toda la experiencia formando parte de nuestro equipo, por eso te ofrecemos:
• ¡ESENCIAL! Contrato indefinido y proyecto estable.
• MODALIDAD: Lliçà de Vall - on site
• CONVIVENCIA EN EQUIPO: Barbacoas, cafés tecnológicos y quizás este año se nos ocurran más cosas para estar más cerca de ti.
• SEGUIMIENTO CONTINUO: Contarás con nuestro fantástico TBM para seguir creciendo y tener feedback de tu rendimiento y día a día.
• DEPARTAMENTO DE CARRERAS Y FORMACIÓN ¿Quieres dar el siguiente paso? ¡Nosotros te acompañamos!
• EVENTOS ESPECIALES: Cena de Verano, Cena de Navidad y Día Solidario
• CUMPLEAÑOS GRATIS: ¡Disfrútalo cómo, dónde y con quién quieras!
• APOYO en guarderías, KM e idiomas.

En K-LAGAN, la igualdad de oportunidades es uno de nuestros valores. Nuestro compromiso es contratar a los mejores talentos independientemente de su raza, religión, sexo, edad y otras capacidades y promover su desarrollo profesional y personal.

¿Crees que puede ser interesante para ti?

¡Ven y presenta tu candidatura

jobs_results.title: Senior Hardware Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Job Description

The path towards a new era of full autonomous vehicles is already set and the rise of central computing paradigms is accelerating the introduction of new in-vehicle networking (IVN) technologies required for the vehicle of the future, like automotive ethernet and SERDES.

To help us develop these concepts, we @Technica-Engineering are building a completely new engineering team located in Barcelona area, and working closely in contact with company headquarters in Munich. This is going to be an interdisciplinary team composed by hardware and software experts focused in the development of company own product roadmap and ProofOfConcepts and Prototypes for clients, mostly OEMs.

What We Offer

Therefore, to build up this team, if you are interested in vehicle connectivity technologies, central computing paradigms and the new mobility trends we are looking for a passionate hardware engineer specialized in electronics to join the team and help us:
• Opportunity to be closer... to main market trend in automotive market within a company working as pure R&D partner for main European OEM.
• High diversity of state-of-the-art projects with technologies 3-4 years beyond what is currently in series production vehicles.
• Opportunity to work in an international environment within a diverse team in close collaboration with our Munich offices. International mobility options available to discuss case-by-case.
• Total integration within the product planning team working in close contact with experienced engineers.
• Professional career development plan tailored individually to maximize opportunities of employee growth.
• Opportunity to further expand your training, from personal abilities to technical areas.
• Opportunity to participate in the growth of a new engineering team from the ground up.
• Company culture oriented to research engineering with a clear reinvestment mindset. Company made by engineers and managed by engineers.
• Attractive professional career development inside the HW group
• Additional extra hours as vacation in exchange.
• Regular team building activities with specific company budget.
• 30 working days as holidays, with full flexibility to manage them.

Main Functions
• Participate in system architecture definition at early project phases and in pure research projects with non-fixed requirements at project kick-off. In this kind of project, be able to give appropriate feedback to customer and internal stakeholders to assure best architecture selection.
• Lead hardware designs, in terms of component selection, schematic creation and PCB layout routing according to the defined processes and procedures. In case PCB layout is done by another engineer or third-party, give support to PCB team according specific power requirements and EMC good practices.
• As a Senior member one of your main tasks consist on support technically but also organizational the other members of the group, focusing also on less experienced members, helping and mentoring them.
• Understand globally product requirements and system architecture with a global view to perform and appropriate hardware design.
• Lead hardware designs, in terms of component selection, schematic creation and PCB layout routing according to the defined processes and procedures. In case PCB layout is done by another engineer or third-party, give support to PCB team according specific power requirements and EMC good practices.
• Be able to make worst case calculation, power deratings & simulations if required to assure design robustness.
• Prepare and execute test plan to assure design quality with specific hardware testing of each block. Perform investigation activities during hardware bring-up and identify and fix problems found on validation or by external parties in the assigned electronic system.
• Prepare EMC/Electrical/ESD test plan and coordinate test activities as well as investigation activities if required.
• Validate and analyze hardware prototype and assure a robust HW-SW integration.
• Technical support within area of expertise to other team members.
• Perform research into new technologies, ideas and trends within your area of expertise and attend relevant conferences or seminars to ensure the organization remains up to date with current technological developments and in the state of the art of all emerging technologies.
• Participate in demos of team capabilities to company management and to customers with creation of prototype setups, sometimes to be presented in fairs where the company is present too.
• Generate accurate periodic reporting of progress and blocking points, to be able to communicate efficiently with the team and with our customers.

Job requirements

Requirements / Skills
• At least 5+ years experience in the development and/or design of hardware for electronic devices.
• Good team first player with strong analytical and investigation skills to work in research projects with new technologies in early design phases.
• Experience leading HW groups with focus on fast prototype and flexible HW development.
• Experience in complex projects with multiple power rails at different voltages and complex architectures with combination of several switching and linear regulators for complex SOC & FPGA devices.
• Experience in low noise and EMI optimization of DC/DC converters and in general hands-on experience on EMI/EMC analysis of power electronics designs.
• Knowledge of thermal management risks and challenges as well as practical knowledge of component selection, thermal modelling, heatsink calculations, etc., to assure performance in intended operation temperature range of the design.
• Knowledge of how to optimize circuit design for ease of manufacturing processes and electronics testing (DFM / DFT).
• Experience and ability to use any kind of laboratory instrumentation (oscilloscopes, active/passive/current probes, power supplies, electronic loads, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers).
• Precise soldering skills (SMD components, fine pitch ICs).
• Knowledge of all switched mode power supply topologies used in automotive designs.
• Experience in power-supply requirements specific for automotive applications, wide input voltage range, cold-cranking, load dump, high voltage protections, quiescent current restrictions, etc. is desirable.
• Knowledge of different communication bus interfaces: I2C, SPI, CAN, CAND-FD, LIN, FLEXRAY, Automotive Ethernet, etc., is desirable.
• Knowledge of specific automotive test regulations (pulses and transient testing, fast voltage drops and micro-interruptions, BCI, EMC/ESD automotive regulations,…) is desirable.
• Practical knowledge of functional safety standards such as ISO26262 is desirable.
• Experience in power integrity design and simulation tools (to analyze voltage drop and current density capacity of power rails, IC switching noise propagation though boards, PDN impedance across different frequencies, etc.) is desirable.
• Experience with Flotherm, Icepak or similar thermal modelling packages is a bonus.
• Fluency in English is a must, German is nice to have. All our customers are from outside Spain.

For additional information in case you want to know more about us, check our website

jobs_results.title: Hardware Design Verification Engineer (ES)
jobs_results.description:
TL;DR :) Digital Design Verification - Application cores - CodAL - RISC-V ISA - Processor Microarchitecture - OOP - Linux-capable cores - CPU - Start-up culture - Soft IP

Locations: Spain (Barcelona)

Department: Spanish Design Center

Employment Type: Full-Time

Flexible working hours, including working from home

Experience: Mid-Senior Level

WHY WE ARE HIRING:

Codasip keeps expanding, diversifying as well as improving the verification domain, so we are happy to present a vacant HW Verification Engineer position in our Spanish Design Center. Moreover, our teams are developing High-Performance RISC-V application processors, including multiple-issue and/or multi-core architectures Besides, once you join Codasip, you will act in daily concert with our Director of Verification - Philippe Luc from the French Office as well as our DV engineers from the UK, France, Greece, Czech Republic, Poland.

YOUR CORE RESPONSIBILITIES WILL BE:
• Verify modern RISC-V processors and their components... to raise the quality of our deliverables
• Create a pre-silicon verification environment, automated tests, and checkers
• Design generic solutions and process automation
• Hunt for bugs by creating and using smart algorithms
• Come up with and realize your own ideas on how to improve, automate or upgrade our technologies on even higher level (you will definitely get our support)

Requirements

YOU NEED TO POSSESS THE FOLLOWING KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:
• Passion for electronics or embedded SW
• Experience with Hardware verification (VHDL/Verilog simulation, Formal or UVM)
• Knowledge of versioning tools (Git -preferred)
• Practical usage of Linux
• Software writing skills (C++ or Python preferred)
• Experience in Object-Oriented Programming
• Communicative English. Our team is highly distributed, so English is the main language
• Eagerness to think outside the box
• Self-organization and reliability

NICE-TO-HAVES:
• Desire to play a role in shaping the RISC-V world of tomorrow
• Knowledge of HDL languages (Verilog, VHDL, or System Verilog)
• DIY activities related to open-source software, home automation, robotics, or similar
• University degree in a related field (Microelectronics, HW design, Embedded SW, Robotics or similar)

Benefits

HOW YOU CAN BE ENRICHED:
• Opportunity to work with RISC-V, computer architecture of the future
• Working on innovative IoT processors and unique processor optimization technology
• Participation in the whole development process from analysis to deployment
• Opportunity to collaborate with experienced developers located in the UK, France, Greece, Germany, Spain, Poland, and the Czech Republic
• Learn and enhance our verification methodologies, using combinations of assertions, random instruction stream generators, online and offline checkers, best-in-class formal tools, various coverage metrics, architecture compliance testing, etc.

WHO IS CODASIP:

Codasip was founded on a simple belief - we could bring together the brilliance of microprocessor architects and software engineers and capture it in tools that make the design simpler, faster, and less expensive. The company was created in 2014 with the mission of democratizing processor design by utilizing our own CodAL architecture description language.

Nowadays Codasip is a leading supplier of processing solutions for IC designers, offering products based on open standards such as the RISC-V ISA, LLVM, and UVM. We are a founding member of RISC-V International (formerly RISC-V Foundation) and we were the first company to offer a commercial RISC-V IP core in 2015. With almost 200 employees and offices in Europe, the US, and China, we are constantly open for talents who want to work on cutting-edge processor technologies, believe in the great potential of RISC-V.

WHAT IS OUR COMPANY CULTURE:

We celebrate a highly professional and open environment, with a well-balanced mix of young and experienced engineers. We employ agile methodologies to bring the speed and ease of software development to hardware as well as to guarantee the high quality of our products. A perfect platform for growth, that will enable you to learn from the best and at the same time drive your own ideas - that is the Codasip DNA.

SOME USEFUL LINKS ON CODASIP:
• Codasip RISC V Processor Solutions
• Design for differentiation: architecture licenses in RISC‑V
• Building a Swiss cheese model approach for processor verification
• Efficient verification of RISC-V processors - Technical paper

We're passionate about RISC-V processors. If you are, apply now

jobs_results.title: Hardware Engineer / Electronic Design Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Clue keeps on growing!

We are now hiring a Hardware Electronic Engineer!

➪ About Clue

Clue is a company specialized in state-of-the-art embedded systems. We research, design, and manufacture high-performance electronic equipment, specifically crafted for critical environments in aviation.

Our motto is to create simple solutions to big problems.

➪ What is the job about?

The main responsibility of the Hardware Electronic Engineer is the research, design, and development of electronic devices for aviation applications.

The Hardware Electronic Engineer works in the HW team within the R&D department in a cross-disciplinary and international environment.

➪ What will you do?

✅ Join a hardware team that is working on the state of the art PCB electronic design.

✅ Plan, document and develop new hardware items from the initial specification and requirements through prototypes to production series.

✅ Designing circuit boards: from capturing schematics to layout (Support to PCB designer... or own layout), testing, and documentation.

✅ Ensure that PCB design meets design specifications.

✅ Work with the latest processors from NXP or Intel and the latest FPGAs from Xilinx and Microchip.

✅ Utilize high-performance technologies such as PCIe Gen 4, DDR4, Ethernet 10/40/100G...

✅ Design high-speed circuits with a high level of complexity in signal density, pushing the manufacturing capacity limits of top PCB manufacturers.

✅ Perform analysis, simulations, and design justifications for the technical architecture proposals.

✅ Support to system definition and regulatory and safety certification

✅ Design, validate and verify the hardware developments.

➪ What profile are we looking for?

Mandatory:
• Telecommunications, Industrial, Electronic Engineering Degree or any other Engineering Degree.
• Must be based in Spain and be willing to occasionally travel to Madrid or Málaga
• 5+ years of experience in the design of hardware products, prototyping, and debugging.
• PCB design over ECAD tools (preferably Altium)
• Experience designing complex, high velocity PCBs (at least 12 layers)
• Electronic simulations (LTSpice, TINA, Saturn…)
• SoC and FPGA designs (NXP, Xiilink, Intel, Microchip) and High-Speed interface designs.

Valuable:
• Relevant experience in an equivalent position in the aerospace industry.
• Background in developing hardware products for avionics equipment over DO-254.
• Background in reliability and safety activities.
• Understanding of EMI/EMC and environmental qualification activities over DO-160.

➪ What do we offer?

📝 Full-time, permanent contract

🛬 Final Company: We are NOT a consulting firm

⌚ Flexible schedule, work-life balance and free Friday afternoons

🏡 Remote work: work from anywhere in Spain with occasional trips to our offices in Madrid or Málaga

🍴 Free meals on days you come to the office

🎓 Training, certifications, and career development plan

🇬🇧 Free English classes

☕ Free coffee and snacks

🩺 Private health insurance

⛱ 25 + 2 vacations days

Clue is committed to the diversity of its teams and an inclusive work environment. We encourage applications from people with different backgrounds, interests, and personal circumstances. Our team welcomes applicants regardless of their race, gender, age, religion, nationality, sexual orientation, and/or disabilities. All we need is your high energy, skills, and willingness to be part of a great project!

If you want to take your career to the next level, apply to our job offer
